name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a Canadian precious metals developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos Silver-Gold Project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The company completed a Definitive Feasibility Study in June 2026 outlining a large-scale development with a US$3.0B NPV and 41.9% IRR, and has secured full environmental permits from provincial authorities. AbraSilver is targeting a Final Investment Decision in Q2 2027 and first silver-gold production by year-end 2029.
